keyword: Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump missing pipe diameter

title.en: Diesel mixer pump does not print a pipe diameter
title.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机没有印管径

description.en: The Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump page has no delivery-pipe diameter. The electric Integrated Mixer Pump page does, at 100 / 125 mm. Do not copy that cell across.
description.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机页面没有输送管内径。电动搅拌泵一体机页面有，是 100 / 125 mm。不要把那一格抄过来。

h1.en: Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump, pipe diameter not printed
h1.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机，未印管径

directAnswer.en: Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump is a diesel mix-and-pump unit made in Xingtai. Its sheet prints output, pressure and stone distances, and it omits delivery-pipe inner diameter. The electric mixer pump's 100 / 125 mm cell stays on the electric page. Mixing-seal sizes are not named on either mixer page.
directAnswer.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机是邢台制造的柴油搅拌泵送一体机。参数印了输送量、压力和石子距离，没有印输送管内径。电动搅拌泵的 100 / 125 mm 留在电动那一页。两张搅拌泵页面都没有点名搅拌密封尺寸。

body.en: Model Diesel Mixer Integrated. Engine 4108 / 66–75 kW. Output 25 m³/h. Maximum outlet pressure 23 MPa. Hopper 0.4 m³. Stone capacity, labelled horizontal / vertical, 100 / 300 m. 13 mm stone 60 / 180 m. 24 mm stone 40 / 120 m. Size 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm. Weight 4200 kg. Series note: 30 model with 400 mixer; 40/50 model with 500 mixer. The 100 / 300 m cell is distance, not a pipe DN.
body.zh: 型号 Diesel Mixer Integrated。柴油机 4108 / 66–75 kW。输送量 25 m³/h。最大出口压力 23 MPa。料斗 0.4 m³。细石输送按水平/垂直标注为 100 / 300 m。13 mm 石子 60 / 180 m。24 mm 石子 40 / 120 m。外形 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm。重量 4200 kg。系列说明：30 机型配 400 搅拌；40/50 机型配 500 搅拌。100 / 300 m 是距离，不是管径。

heading.en: The electric mixer page is not a donor
heading.zh: 电动搅拌泵页不能借数

body.en: Integrated Mixer Pump prints delivery pipe 100 / 125 mm, main motor 45 kW / mixer 14 kW, output 21 m³/h and pressure 23 MPa. Sharing a 400/500 mixer note does not copy the pipe cell. Mixing seals φ65 and φ80, and the generation kits, do not name either mixer.
body.zh: 搅拌泵一体机印了输送管 100 / 125 mm、主电机 45 kW / 搅拌电机 14 kW、输送量 21 m³/h、压力 23 MPa。两边都提到 400/500 搅拌，也不会把管径格抄过去。搅拌密封 φ65、φ80 和分代套件都没有点名这两台搅拌泵。

body.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. For a straight pipe or hose, name Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump and state that DN is not printed. For a mixing seal, name the seal row you checked on the machine, not the 400 or 500 mixer note.
body.zh: 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 直管或胶管请写柴油搅拌泵一体机，并写明公称直径没有印出。搅拌密封请写在机器上核对到的密封行，不要写 400 或 500 搅拌说明。

answer.en: No. The label is stone conveying, horizontal / vertical, in metres.
answer.zh: 不是。这一格的标签是细石输送，水平/垂直，单位是米。

question.en: Can I use the electric mixer's 100 / 125 mm?
question.zh: 能用电动搅拌泵的 100 / 125 mm 吗？

answer.en: Only on an inquiry for the electric Integrated Mixer Pump. This diesel page does not print it.
answer.zh: 只有询价对象是电动搅拌泵一体机时可以。这张柴油页没有印这个数字。

answer.en: No. Generation and upper-pump seal kits are on the mixing-seal page, with no model name.
answer.zh: 没有。分代和上泵密封套件在搅拌密封页上，没有型号名。

answer.en: A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank.
answer.zh: 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。

label.en: Email or WhatsApp the Xingtai factory
label.zh: 邮件或 WhatsApp 联系邢台工厂
